messages:
maria: quick sync \/ updating the Hello world quickstart to prefer REDWOOD_KEY env var across examples + clarifying the first deploy step. want to coordinate docs, example app, and SDK snippet PRs. PRs: https:\/\/github.com\/redwood\/quickstart\/pull\/487 (WIP), https:\/\/github.com\/redwood\/sdk-js\/pull\/210 (snippets).

alex: can we also add a tiny migration note for customers using infra templates? some infra repos still read REDWOOD_API_KEY from cloudsecret.

maria: good call. plan: change examples to use REDWOOD_KEY (with fallback to REDWOOD_API_KEY). update .env.sample, README snippets, and quickstart deploy instructions. add short migration note: "REDWOOD_API_KEY remains supported; prefer REDWOOD_KEY going forward."

devon: i'll update the JS/TS snippet in the SDK repo. proposed minimal snippet (named import + async):
```js
import { RedwoodClient } from '@redwoodai/sdk';
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY || process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });
(async () => {
  const res = await client.generate({ model: 'redwood/ft-1', prompt: 'Hello world' });
  console.log(res.text);
})();
```

lila: i'll push .env.sample and README edits in quickstart. also found a stale internal link in the deploy guide pointing to /docs/legacy/quickstart; will swap to /docs/quickstart/helloapp and add anchor notes.

sachin: add a brief token scope note (generate/read) and a security callout: blur tokens in screenshots and avoid hard-coding. Also suggest rotation guidance for org docs.

alex: for infra templates I'll open a tiny PR to look for REDWOOD_API_KEY references and add a comment about the fallback.

maria: curl example for docs? keep it compact, POST with Authorization header. devon, can you add that to the SDK snippets PR?

devon: yup. curl idea:
```
curl -X POST https:\/\/api.redwood.ai\/v1\/generate \\\n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \\\n  -H "Content-Type: application\/json" \\\n  -d '{"model":"redwood\/ft-1","prompt":"Hi"}'
```
I'll also add a tiny jest test in sdk/examples that asserts the Authorization header when env var present (mock fetch).

lila: added a 1200px width blurred Console token screenshot and updated the quickstart PR. kept image size under 200kb.

docs-bot: preview deployed: https:\/\/deploy-preview-487--docs.redwood.ai (quickstart) and https:\/\/deploy-preview-210--sdk.redwood.ai (snippets) :white_check_mark:

devon: left one nit on named import vs default in SDK PR; changed to named `RedwoodClient` and added the test.

sachin: reviewing wording now. suggestion: add a one-sentence line under Quickstart: "If you used REDWOOD_API_KEY previously your setup will continue to work without changes."

maria: added CHANGELOG note under docs: "quickstart: prefer REDWOOD_KEY in examples; keep REDWOOD_API_KEY fallback." also opened follow-up ticket to add CLI token creation guide.

alex: infra-template PR opened to patch references and add comment about fallback.

lila: assigned reviewers @devon @sachin. merging once SDK and quickstart previews are green.

devon: approved SDK PR; will merge after quickstart preview.

docs-bot: quickstart preview passed visual diff checks.

maria: merged both PRs. follow-up items: add plain-English Console token helper for non-devs, and a short note about rotation + KMS for enterprise.

sachin: happy to draft the rotation + KMS blurb for enterprise docs.

maria: thanks all. closing this sync. ping here if regressions appear. :tada:
